definitions.explanation: Having many different forms, types, or elements. Used to describe variety in people, opinions, cultures, methods, and more.

examples.japanese: {多様|たよう}な⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{多様|たよう}な⟦{働|はたら}き{方|かた}→働き方：25439_hatarakikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: Diverse ways of working are being sought.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多様|たよう}な⟦{文化|ぶんか}→文化：01504_bunka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{暮|く}らしている→暮らす：01937_kurasu⟧。
examples.english: People with diverse cultures live in this area.

notes:
A な-adjective formed from ⟦{多様|たよう}→多様：12180_tayou⟧, a compound of {多|た} (many) and {様|よう} (manner, form). Very common in formal writing, news, and discussions about society, education, and business.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {多様|たよう}な⟦{価値観|かちかん}→価値観：10431_kachikan⟧ — diverse values
- {多様|たよう}な⟦ニーズ→ニーズ：11244_niizu⟧ — diverse needs
- {多様|たよう}な⟦{人材|じんざい}→人材：11426_jinzai⟧ — diverse talent/personnel
- {多様|たよう}な⟦{選択肢|せんたくし}→選択肢：14418_sentakushi⟧ — various options
- ⟦{多様性|たようせい}→多様性：04825_tayousei⟧ — diversity (noun form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{様々|さまざま}→様々：01559_samazama⟧な — various (slightly more casual, very common)
- ⟦{色々|いろいろ}→色々：02352_iroiro⟧な — various (more casual, everyday use)
- ⟦{多彩|たさい}→多彩：12165_tasai⟧な — colorful, varied (emphasizes richness)
